cycleSardiniaEs.name: Group size
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Our tours are designed for small groups to ensure a safe, enjoyable, and high-quality experience. A minimum of 4 participants is required to organize the tour. The maximum number of participants is 14, which allows us to provide attentive service, maintain safety on the road, and ensure a personalized experience throughout the tour.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Price
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: The published price is based on the standard group size of 4 people. For larger groups, we may be able to offer a reduced price per person. Please contact us for a personalised quotation based on your group size and travel dates.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Difficulty
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Our e-bike tours are specially designed for recreational cyclists who enjoy discovering the region at a relaxed pace. These tours focus on enjoying the landscape, cultural heritage, and history of the area. Thanks to electric assistance, these routes are accessible to almost everyone with a basic  level of fitness. However, it's important to note that we divide the tours into three difficulty levels, based on distance and elevation gain. While the e-bike takes much of the physical effort out of cycling, longer distances or greater elevation can still make for a more challenging ride.
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: To participate in these cycling holidays, it’s important that you have a good basic fitness level, cycle regularly, and are comfortable shifting gears efficiently when climbing, this will greatly enhance your enjoyment on the road.
cycleSardiniaEs.text3: See Blog for more information “Cycle Grades Tour E-Bike”

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Accommodations
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Accommodation is provided in carefully selected hotels that offer a comfortable and relaxing stay throughout the tour. The accommodations include breakfast and provide attentive service, often with facilities such as a restaurant, bar, garden, and swimming pool.  Rooms are standard single or double rooms with private bathrooms, depending on the hotel. For smaller groups, private rooms are available for all participants. However, for larger groups, room sharing may be necessary due to hotel capacity and availability. In such cases, participants will be accommodated in shared twin or double rooms. Regardless of the room allocation, we always select hotels that meet our standards for comfort, quality, and service

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Optional activities
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: Make the most of your day by extending your cycling tour with a delicious lunch by the beach. After your ride, you can unwind, enjoy a leisurely meal, and spend the afternoon relaxing by the sea.
cycleSardiniaEs.text3: As this turns the half-day cycling tour into a full-day excursion, an additional charge applies.
cycleSardiniaEs.text4: Please contact us for pricing and availability, and we'll be happy to provide all the details and help you arrange this optional experience.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Weather in Granada
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: Spring is an excellent time for mountain biking in the province of Granada, with pleasant temperatures and long daylight hours. However, due to the varying altitudes, weather conditions can differ significantly between regions.
